name: Caravan Guard
text: You rode the trade roads for coin. You know which merchants pay and which roads get people killed.

benefits.name: Road Sense
benefits.text: Joins caravan escort bounties first and haggles a better reward.

name: Disgraced Councillor
text: You held a seat in another town until a scandal took it. You still know how a vote is bought.

benefits.name: Old Friends
benefits.text: Can stand for a council seat sooner than other heroes, and is a likely target for bribes.

name: Fog Runner
text: You carried messages between frontier forts through the mist for a few coppers a run.

benefits.name: Mist Legs
benefits.text: Returns from expeditions faster and brings back an extra sighting.

name: Frontier Settler
text: You came with the first wagons and cleared the first fields. This town is yours as much as the mayor's.

benefits.name: Rooted
benefits.text: Never leaves town over low pay, and fights hardest when the town is attacked.

name: Guild Apprentice
text: You learned a trade under a master before the road called. The guild still counts you as one of its own.

benefits.name: Guild Ties
benefits.text: Buys gear at guild prices and brings the guild's news to the tavern.

name: Herb Gatherer
text: You picked bloodmoss and ghostcap for the alchemists, deeper into the wilds every season.

benefits.name: Forager
benefits.text: Brings reagents home from every expedition.

benefits.name: Gatherer's Kit
benefits.text: Starts with a sickle, a satchel of jars and a healer's poultice.

name: Lapsed Initiate
text: You knelt in a cellar temple until you saw what it was for. You still recognise the signs.

benefits.name: Old Hand Signs
benefits.text: Slowly reveals cult agents on the council, but the cult sends assassins after them.

name: Plague Survivor
text: Your village was lost to a plague caravan and you walked out of the burning alone. You never got sick again.

benefits.name: Immune Memory
benefits.text: Can tend the sick in a quarantined district without catching the disease.

name: Relic Peddler
text: You sold saints' bones and lucky shards from a cart. Some were even real.

benefits.name: Eye for Shards
benefits.text: Spots genuine relic fragments among junk, and sells fakes to merchants at a profit.

benefits.name: Peddler's Cart
benefits.text: Starts with a handcart and one real relic fragment.

name: Toll Collector
text: You sat at a bridge gate and took the lord's coin from every wagon. You know every trick a smuggler tries.

benefits.name: Counting House
benefits.text: Caravans they inspect pay full toll, and smuggled goods are seized for the treasury.

name: Turncoat Raider
text: You rode with an orc warband until you could not stomach it. They want you dead; you know how they think.

benefits.name: Knows the Warband
benefits.text: Warns the town before a raid and reveals warband camp locations, but raiders target them on sight.

name: Wall Mason
text: You laid stone on three towns' walls before you picked up a sword. You know where walls fail.

benefits.name: Mortar and Stone
benefits.text: Repairs wall breaches during a siege and spots weak sections before raiders do.
